19482.overview:
We love dubstep, and odds are if you’re reading this you enjoy it too. There’s nothing like a sick kick/snare and drum build leading into a filthy drop. There’s something so completely satisfying about the wubs. Like a beautiful woman…

We wanted to capture that experience and make it interactive.

You want a story? Stick to Walt Disney. You want Dubstep? Stick to DUBWARS. Your powerful weapons fire to the rhythm and beat, use them to survive the onslaught of waves of enemies. Collect power-ups, upgrade weapons, complete missions and level up.

You’ve felt the Bass Drop, now experience it!

19511.overview: The Donut Shoppe is ablaze, Donuts are raining from the sky and citizens occupy the streets. Officer Brown must create order by eating as many donuts as he can until the fire department comes.
